title: Motorcycle Flat Tire Booster – Emergency Two-Wheeler Support | PowerXpert
body_html:
When facing a flat tire emergency on your motorcycle, the Adjustable Galvanized Steel Vehicle Wheel Dolly by PowerXpert offers immediate, reliable support. This innovative two-wheeler emergency tool ensures you can safely move your bike to a repair spot without further damage or struggle. Designed for Indian roads and riders, it is an essential tool every motorcyclist needs for peace of mind.

Do not let a flat tire ruin your ride. The PowerXpert Adjustable Galvanized Steel Vehicle Wheel Dolly simplifies emergency situations, allowing you to easily handle and maneuver your two-wheeler. Whether it is a puncture, low air pressure, or general maintenance, this robust tool offers the stability and mobility required to get your bike where it needs to be. Its user-friendly design means you do not need to be a mechanic to operate it; simply position it, and move your motorcycle with minimal effort. This is more than just a tool; it is your reliable partner on every journey, providing crucial bike tire support when you need it most.

Key features

  • Supports motorcycles and two-wheelers weighing up to 500 kg.
  • Equipped with 4 smooth-gliding wheels for effortless movement and maneuverability.
  • Features an ABS threaded joint for secure and gentle connection to the tire.
  • Constructed from durable galvanized steel with an anti-slip design for enhanced safety and stability.
  • Ideal for handling flat tires, punctures, or general wheel maintenance.
  • Compact and lightweight, making it easy to store and carry on your rides.
  • Designed to minimise strain and effort when moving heavy bikes.

Materials & care

This Adjustable Galvanized Steel Vehicle Wheel Dolly is crafted from high-quality, durable galvanized steel, ensuring longevity and robust performance. The anti-slip coating enhances safety during use. To maintain its condition, simply wipe clean with a damp cloth after use. Store in a dry place away from direct moisture to prevent corrosion and ensure it is ready for your next emergency.

FAQ

Q1: What is the primary use of this Adjustable Galvanized Steel Vehicle Wheel Dolly?
A: It is designed to help you easily move a motorcycle or two-wheeler that has a flat tire, puncture, or needs general wheel maintenance, allowing you to transport it to a repair shop without damaging the wheel further.
Q2: What is the maximum weight capacity?
A: The PowerXpert Wheel Dolly can safely support and move two-wheelers weighing up to 500 kg.
Q3: Is this suitable for all types of motorcycles?
A: It is generally suitable for most two-wheelers and motorcycles within the 500 kg weight limit. Its adjustable design allows it to accommodate various tire sizes.
Q4: How do I use the wheel dolly?
A: Simply place the dolly under the flat tire, ensuring the ABS threaded joint securely connects to the tire. Once in place, the smooth-gliding wheels allow you to effortlessly maneuver your motorcycle.
Q5: What material is the dolly made from?
A: The dolly is constructed from durable galvanized steel with an anti-slip coating for optimal performance and safety.
